name: Apple Inc.
business_description: Designs, manufactures, and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories, and sells a variety of related services.
peer_notes: High hardware margin mix vs software peers.

name: Microsoft Corporation
business_description: Develops and supports software, services, devices and solutions including Azure cloud, Office 365 productivity suite, and Windows.
peer_notes: June 30 fiscal year end differs from AAPL (Sept) and GOOGL (Dec).

name: Alphabet Inc.
business_description: Holding company for Google, Google Cloud, YouTube, and Other Bets; primary revenues derived from digital advertising and cloud infrastructure.

name: Tata Consultancy Services Limited
business_description: Leading global IT services, consulting, and business solutions organisation delivering enterprise technology transformation.
peer_notes: Direct peer to Infosys and HCLTech; March 31 fiscal year-end.

name: Infosys Limited
business_description: Global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting; reports in INR (BSE/NSE) and USD (SEC Form 20-F).
peer_notes: INR consolidated Ind AS presentation selected for parity with TCS and HCLTech.

name: HCL Technologies Limited
business_description: Global technology company delivering digital, engineering, and software products & platforms services across diverse industry verticals.
peer_notes: Includes significant Products & Platforms segment revenue.

name: Hindustan Unilever Limited
business_description: India's largest fast-moving consumer goods company with home care, beauty & personal care, and foods & refreshment categories.
peer_notes: FY21 revenue reflects inorganic merger of GSK Consumer Healthcare.

name: Britannia Industries Limited
business_description: Major Indian food and bakery manufacturer known for biscuits, bread, cakes, rusk, and dairy products.
peer_notes: Higher raw material commodity sensitivity (wheat, palm oil, dairy) than personal care peers.

name: Dabur India Limited
business_description: Ayurvedic and natural healthcare company manufacturing consumer health, personal care, and food & beverage products.
peer_notes: Higher international exposure (MENA/Turkey) and seasonal health product demand.

name: Maruti Suzuki India Limited
business_description: India's largest passenger car manufacturer; subsidiary of Suzuki Motor Corporation.
peer_notes: CAVEAT: 4-wheeler passenger vehicle manufacturer with large capex cycles; not directly interchangeable with 2-wheelers.

name: Bajaj Auto Limited
business_description: Leading manufacturer of motorcycles, three-wheelers, and quadricycles with strong international export business.
peer_notes: 2-wheeler/3-wheeler business economics and customer financing subsidiary differ from Maruti.

name: Hero MotoCorp Limited
business_description: World's largest manufacturer of two-wheelers by unit volume, focusing on entry and executive commuter motorcycles and scooters.
peer_notes: 100% two-wheeler focus with domestic commuter skew; high peer comparability with Bajaj Auto 2W segment.

name: Walmart Inc.
business_description: Global omnichannel retail and wholesale powerhouse operating discount department stores, supercenters, Sam's Clubs, and e-commerce.
peer_notes: January 31 fiscal year-end; massive volume grocery skew.

name: Costco Wholesale Corporation
business_description: Operates membership warehouses based on high volume, low margin sales and recurring membership fee revenues.
peer_notes: CAVEAT: Low gross margin (~12%) structurally offset by high-margin membership fees; differ from standard retail.

name: Target Corporation
business_description: General merchandise retailer offering everyday essentials and fashion-forward apparel and home goods across store and digital channels.
peer_notes: Higher discretionary merchandise mix (apparel/home) results in greater margin variability.
